scope: DXF reader callback coordinate preparation for classic POLYLINE when dxfRW::read explicitly requests applyExtrusion; no physical-source or support claim

authority.title: Autodesk POLYLINE (DXF)
rules: A 2D POLYLINE's group-30 elevation is in OCS; 3D POLYLINE elevation is in WCS.
Flag 8 identifies a 3D POLYLINE, flag 16 identifies a 3D polygon mesh, and flag 64 identifies a polyface mesh.

authority.title: Autodesk VERTEX (DXF)
authority.rule: 2D vertex location is in the owning polyline's OCS; 3D vertex location is in WCS.

authority.title: Autodesk Vertex2d.Position Property
authority.rule: The vertex's OCS Z member is not the effective elevation; the owning 2D polyline supplies OCS Z through its elevation.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The OCS basis is computed from the extrusion normal using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behavior: DRW_Polyline::applyExtrusion converts ordinary 2D POLYLINE vertices using the owning polyline's elevation and the existing arbitrary-axis basis.
The 2D header elevation anchor is transformed to WCS; each vertex's historical Z value does not override the parent elevation.
3D POLYLINE, 3D polygon mesh, and polyface mesh flags bypass this OCS transform because their coordinates are WCS.
The processPolyline callback invokes this only when dxfRW::read(..., applyExtrusion=true) is selected; the default false option preserves OCS data.

3dPolyline.expected: unchanged with applyExtrusion false or true

generatedControl.framingControl: A following WCS LINE is read with its endpoints unchanged after both owned VERTEX/SEQEND sequences.
